hook: The inspector found 2 problems. Now no one can buy it.
cta_sub: Cash, as-is, close in as few as 21 days. Florida.

beats.say: The inspector says the foundation is shifting. And the roof is done.
Our buyer's bank just backed out. They won't lend on a house like this.
And it's leaking into the kitchen while I stand here.
Morning Derek. I'm Casa. Here's the thing. We don't need a bank.
What do you mean you don't need a bank?
We buy with cash. No lender, so nobody can back out over the roof or the foundation.
Then you'll just lowball me because of the repairs.
We'll show you the whole math. Repair costs, what fixed up homes nearby sold for, and what we can pay. No surprises, no obligation.
Do I have to fix anything first?
Nothing. No repairs, no showings, no inspections to pass. You hand us the keys as is.
And you're not alone. In one homeowner survey, more than a third said speed and certainty mattered more to them than getting top dollar.
Honestly, certainty sounds amazing right now.
We can close in as few as twenty one days. Or wait, if you need time to find your next place.
If your Florida house needs repairs you can't afford, DM the word OFFER, and get a cash offer on it as is.
